learning_outcomes.text: Able to manage the Public Relations Process of Art Activities.
Able to plan image-building activities with the target audience.
Able to perform strategic work that highlights creativity by acquiring the necessary theoretical background in Public Relations.
Able to analyze and evaluate Public Relations campaigns.
